s.t:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com .
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
The opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager for our Supply Domain, which is an engineering organization of roughly 30 people.
To support our scaling goals, we are looking for a hands-on leader with a builder mentality who can speed up our integrations and deliver features fast without simply multiplying the team size. You will take calculated risks, navigate unknowns, and ensure we leverage our investments in tooling and engineering transformation to meet our core product goals.
What will you do
Own one of our Domains from the Engineering and delivery standpoint.
Manage, lead, and grow our Engineering teams (people development, people engagement, hiring, etc.).
Drive integration efficiency by executing a consolidated strategy, accelerating feature delivery without linearly increasing headcount.
Partner proactively with the TPM teams, fostering real collaboration.
Take ownership of specific parts of the product, ensuring on-time launches, operational excellence, and successful client exposure.
Manage team performance pragmatically, setting clear goals, tracking progress, and acting decisively to keep the team in top shape.
Navigate and manage risk, confidently handling unknowns while pushing forward complex technical initiatives.
Take responsibility for the architectural design within the domain.
Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid
With the HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office, and also with teams located around the Globe.
Who are you
You are an experienced People leader who has managed people leaders in the past and guided organizational growth.
You are a well-rounded Engineer who can address technical issues yourself if needed.
You bring a strong product mindset and a hands-on, "builder" mentality, willing to take calculated risks and proactively push strategies through to execution.
You show a pragmatic approach to team optimization and performance management, and know how to maintain a healthy, high-functioning organization.
You are ideally coming from a fast-paced environment where you have experienced true engineering transformation.
You drive active hiring processes, bringing proven experience in identifying top talent.

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineering Manager to lead one of our data engineering teams. This is a hands-on player-coach role for someone who can develop engineers, guide technical architecture, and contribute directly to the systems that support our products, AI platforms, and customer-facing data feeds.
You will own critical central data pipelines built on large-scale alternative datasets, including transaction data, email receipt data, B2B spend data, and other third-party datasets. Your team will transform complex data into reliable, production-grade assets used by research analysts, product teams, and internal applications.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who combines strong technical judgment, operational rigor, people leadership, and modern AI-assisted development practices. You should be comfortable using tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar systems to accelerate implementation, code review, testing, documentation, debugging, and technical exploration while maintaining a high bar for correctness, reliability, and production ownership.
What You’ll Own
You will lead the data engineering team responsible for building and scaling data systems for all of YipitData’s businesses, including:
Large scale data pipelines built for the public investor business units, corporate investor team, and/or private investor team
Production datasets and analytical models used in research workflows, applications, internal products, and customer-facing deliverables.
Architecting data flows and data models to support various business stakeholders use cases focusing on accuracy, timeliness, and reliability.
AI-ready analytical datasets designed with the structure, metadata, documentation, and business context needed for effective use by AI agents..
Data quality and observability frameworks , including validation checks, freshness monitoring, coverage monitoring, outlier detection, and automated QA controls.
Technical execution across Databricks, Airflow, SQL, PySpark , and related data infrastructure.
Operational excellence practices across documentation, incident response, monitoring, reliability, and production support.

Lead, coach, and develop a global team of data engineers while staying close to architecture, design, code reviews, debugging, and delivery.
Partner with Technical Product Managers and Data leads to translate roadmap priorities, customer needs, and research requirements into scalable technical plans.
Build and improve scalable data pipelines, data models, and QA systems for various data products.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and PMs to support reliable delivery of data pipelines, incident resolution, methodologies, and operational improvements.
Use AI coding tools to develop and enhance methodologies, accelerate engineering execution, improve documentation, strengthen QA, support technical exploration, and raise team productivity.
Create clarity and momentum in ambiguous environments by breaking down complex data, research, and product challenges into actionable engineering plans.

From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we’re in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic.

Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it. What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that’s scaling rapidly.

We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities. For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base.

For their clients, we’re where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant. Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges.

If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here.

However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy .

The people you’ll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting: As an Associate Data Platform Engineering Manager reporting to the Head of Data Engineering in our Data & Analytics - Data Platform Engineering team, your purpose will be to lead a small, high-impact team of 2-3 platform engineers while staying heavily involved in hands-on technical work.

You’ll split your time between people leadership - coaching your team, driving agile delivery, and managing OKRs - and engineering tasks.

You will design reliable Terraform/Terragrunt modules on GCP, champion data security controls (Dataplex, DLP), and establish standard, self-service developer tools that empower our downstream data teams to build with confidence.

Requirements Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you’re going to need… Dual Track Experience: 5+ years of experience in data platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with initial experience leading, mentoring, or managing tech teams.

Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep, practical experience using Terraform/Terragrunt to architect and manage infrastructure, preferably on Google Cloud Platform. Advanced Platform Skillset: Strong familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, GKE, IAM) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

Platform-as-a-Product Mindset: A strong focus on customer enablement, platform reliability, system governance, and security. English Fluency: At a minimum, we require professional English language skills (B2 level or higher). Why?

English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to communicate smoothly to feel like an integrated part of Booksy . It will also help you to have… Modern Open-Source Tools: An open-source-first mindset when researching, evaluating, or building internal platform tools.

Next-Gen Architectures: Exposure to PySpark and open table formats (Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake). AI Integration: Experience or strong interest in applying AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude) and monitoring LLM-driven pipelines.

Benefits Some of the benefits we offer are: We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first. Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.

Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists. Work in a welcoming team which is always ready to help. Opportunity to develop in an international environment - we have teams in 6 countries.

How AI helps us find great people Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don’t worry, AI never makes the decisions.

Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories.

The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance.

The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review.

You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.
So what does it take to be successful in this role?
You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment.

You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover.

You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies.

You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities.

Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

Location: Remote, US (preferably in Mountain Time Zone) Employment Type: Full-Time Switchfly is hiring a Director of Engineering. We build the loyalty and travel booking platform behind some of the world's largest airlines and financial institutions.

It is a complex, regulated, multi-tenant SaaS environment where the work is real, and the stakes are high. We focus on high-value products that solve clearly identified problems, built to keep delivering value over the long term.

We want a leader who can see where travel and loyalty are heading as AI-driven discovery, conversational commerce, and new ecosystem models to reshape them, and who can build toward that future while delivering in the present. We serve market-leading travel and financial clients through one white-label platform: a single product behind many brands.

The leader we want digs into what each client needs, then builds capabilities that serve many clients rather than one-off features for a single account. Strong partnerships across internal teams and clients will be central to your success.

If you want to own outcomes rather than ship tickets, and to work where engineering leadership meets product vision in a company where your decisions visibly matter, this role is for you. Responsibilities Own the product outcomes for your teams, not just their delivery.

You define what success looks like for the parts of the platform you own, set clear OKRs, and hold your teams to business results rather than sprint velocity. Drive AI on two fronts, as a product capability and as a development practice.

You shape the vision for AI-powered platform features, and you partner with our existing advocates to speed up agentic coding adoption, setting the guardrails, tooling standards, and culture that make it stick inside a PCI Level 1-compliant SDLC. Actively direct the data science team.

Stay hands-on rather than delegating, and steer the team toward the data and model capabilities that power the AI-native commerce features you own. Act as servant leader to cross-functional agile teams, with responsibility to mentor, manage, and lead your direct reports.

Coach Product Owners to grow from backlog managers into outcome-oriented thinkers, pushing them to connect features to business value, client impact, and measurable results. Identify, mentor, and grow senior development leads into development managers, strengthening the management layer beneath you.

Work across the business, including Switchfly 's executive leadership and our clients, translating strategic intent into engineering scope with clarity and appropriate pushback. Guide the personal and career development of your people. Ensure teams work together and that each person has a voice.

Foster a culture that encourages learning, trust, and bravery. About you: 5+ years leading software engineering teams in Agile delivery environments, with a track record of owning outcomes rather than just managing process.

Hands-on experience driving AI-assisted and agentic development adoption at team or company scale, including the hard parts: security guardrails, policy definition, cultural resistance, and measuring real productivity impact. You also bring a real point of view on building AI-native product features, not only using AI to write code.

A foundation in software development. You have built and shipped production software, and you retain enough technical depth to challenge architectural decisions, weigh engineering tradeoffs, and earn the respect of experienced developers.

We are especially interested in leaders whose strength includes the frontend and the customer-facing shopping experience; depth there, rather than a purely backend background, will stand out. Experience operating in a regulated compliance environment such as PCI DSS or SOC 2, where security and process discipline are non-negotiable.

You understand how B2B2C businesses create value, where the client, the end user, and the platform's commercial model are three distinct things that all have to win. Consumer-only product instincts, however strong, are not enough here.

You are comfortable owning product direction, partnering with Product Owners to shape what gets built and why, not just how fast it ships. You delegate effectively and are detail-oriented when required. You are inquisitive and eager to learn, always looking for better approaches and bringing an outside perspective to the team.

You bring innovative, action-oriented energy: you move fast, form opinions, and drive change, with the maturity to operate within the realities of a complex, regulated enterprise platform. Your colleagues are inspired to follow your lead.

About the Technology Loyalty and travel booking are being reshaped by LLM-based discovery, conversational commerce, and new ecosystem partnerships, and the teams you lead sit right at that shift.
